'''Thea''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Wandering P'orp]]''.
